translations.auth.forgot.title: Forgot your password
translations.auth.forgot.sent: If an account uses {$START_TAG_STRONG}{$INTERPOLATION}{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}, a link to choose a new password is on its way. It works for 30 minutes.
translations.auth.forgot.sentHint: Nothing after a few minutes? Check the spam folder, or ask again: only the newest link works.
translations.auth.forgot.intro: Type the email of your account: we send you a link to choose a new password.
translations.auth.forgot.error: The link could not be sent. Please try again.
translations.auth.login.title: Log in
translations.auth.register.title: Create your account
translations.auth.register.intro: Free forever: your library, bookmarks and reading progress, on every device.
translations.auth.register.usernameMin: Username must be at least {$min} characters
translations.auth.register.usernameMax: Username must be at most {$max} characters
translations.auth.register.usernamePattern: Only letters, digits, "_", "." and "-" are allowed
translations.auth.register.passwordMin: Password must be at least {$min} characters
translations.auth.register.passwordMax: Password must be at most {$max} characters
translations.auth.reset.title: Choose a new password
translations.auth.reset.done: Your password is changed. Every device was signed out: log in with the new password.
translations.auth.reset.noToken: This page opens from the link in the email we send. Ask for one first.
translations.auth.reset.newMin: The new password needs at least {$min} characters
translations.auth.reset.newMax: The new password must be at most {$max} characters
translations.auth.reset.mismatch: The two new passwords are not the same
translations.auth.reset.error: Your password could not be changed. Please try again.
